about: CF-247 usage audit decisions D6, D7, D9 and D10 (Platform Admin, 15 Oct 2026 22:12: "Proceed with D6, D7, D9 and D10"). Rows exported here before the paste file purges or drops them. Each set's select is the exact row set the paste file removes; the paste file refuses to run unless the row count and key hash still match this export.

sets.name: layer3_work_items_purged
sets.select: select w.* from pipeline.layer3_work_items w where w.task_class <> 'provider_current_tuition_validation' and w.status in ('admitted', 'no_candidate', 'superseded') and not exists (select 1 from pipeline.adapter_shadow_reads x where x.work_item_id = w.id)

sets.name: layer3_interpretations_purged
sets.select: select i.* from pipeline.layer3_interpretations i where not exists (select 1 from pipeline.layer3_work_items w where w.interpretation_id = i.id and not (w.task_class <> 'provider_current_tuition_validation' and w.status in ('admitted', 'no_candidate', 'superseded') and not exists (select 1 from pipeline.adapter_shadow_reads x where x.work_item_id = w.id))) and not exists (select 1 from pipeline.layer4_review_items r where r.layer3_interpretation_id = i.id) and not exists (select 1 from pipeline.scholarship_ai_run_items s where s.interpretation_id = i.id)
